title: 夜蝶换位
brief: Silent partner dance. X on left and N on right face each other, take a small bow, sidestep past each other with X nearer the camera, arrive visibly exchanged, look back; reverse the arc past each other, return to their original positions. Medium full shot for footwork; keep bodies individually readable.

board.title: 夜蝶换位
poses: 0.00 s: Draw X on the left and N on the right, facing each other upright, feet together and open hands beside their hips.
0.55 s: Draw both making a small bow toward each other, heads lowered, knees soft and hands beside their thighs.
1.10 s: Draw both rising and sidestepping inward, X diagonally forward and right, N diagonally back and left, eyes meeting.
1.65 s: Draw X passing rightward in the foreground and N leftward behind, with lateral spacing keeping both bodies, feet and hands readable.
2.20 s: Draw X clearly on the right and N on the left, feet planted and torsos angled outward, looking back over their shoulders at each other.
2.75 s: Draw both pivoting inward to reverse their paths, X stepping left along the foreground arc and N right along the background arc.
3.30 s: Draw X passing leftward in front and N rightward behind, heads turned toward each other and silhouettes clearly separated.
3.85 s: Draw X reaching the original left mark and N the original right mark, trailing feet drawing inward and torsos turning toward each other.
4.40 s: Draw both facing each other at their original marks, feet close, heels slightly raised and knees softly bent, ready to settle upright into pose one.
board.continuity: Use one silent 4.8-second loop with a fixed medium full shot, consistent identities, no props, continuously visible hands and feet, connected gaze changes, and a smooth settling motion from pose nine into pose one.
